support_claim: The packet links MER-55 to the name Meridian Energy Partners and billing to Meridian Energy Partners LLC, but no observation explicitly establishes that these referents denote the same legal counterparty.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing identity and DISTINCT requires establishing distinctness; name similarity and contextual association without a direct identity link are insufficient, and the packet provides no observation that confirms or denies that crm:MER-55 and billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC are the same entity.
